Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team found the latency/cost numbers compelling. A few follow-ups from our side on data handling before we move forward: 

- PII: We need confirmation on how PII is handled in transit and at rest. We expect automatic redaction for SSNs and payment card numbers by default, or at minimum a documented approach to PII detection.
- Training on customer data: AcmeFin will not allow model-improvement training on our data. We require a written opt-out and that the flag is applied to our account (including staging).
- Logging & retention: We need logs (request/response metadata only) retained for 90 days and a way to export audit logs for compliance reviews. Response payloads with PII must not be stored in long-term logs.
- Data residency: Production must stay in us-west-2. We may allow EU for backup only after legal signs off.

Can you confirm these are all supported and provide a short note we can share with our procurement/legal team? If possible, we prefer a signed opt-out form.

Next steps: please loop in legal/SE as needed.

Sam — thanks for the clear summary and for the time today. Quick post-call recap and how we can address each ask: 

1) PII handling:
- Redwood supports PII detection and redaction pipelines. By default we do not persist raw customer PII in long-term logs; payloads containing detected PII are truncated/masked in the long-term logging tier. We can share our PII handling doc and SOC 2 summary (attached).

2) Training on customer data (opt-out):
- We have an account-level config flag (training_on_customer_data = false) that prevents usage of customer data for model training or improvements. When set, data used by your requests will not be included in model-updates or internal training datasets.
- I will prepare an opt-out confirmation letter for your legal team to sign. For hosted accounts we can flip the flag immediately once we have written instruction/ack; for Dedicated/Private it may require a contract amendment.

3) Logging & retention:
- Default request/response metadata retention can be set to 90 days for your account. Full response payloads (where present) are retained only in ephemeral caches unless explicitly captured; we will configure your account to avoid long-term storage of response payloads containing PII. Audit log exports are available via the Console or via our export API.

4) Data residency:
- We can pin your production tenant to us-west-2. Backups and secondary regions can be discussed with legal if required.

Action items: 
- Marissa: Draft and send opt-out confirmation for signature (today) — DONE (draft attached).
- Rishi (SE): Confirm staging environment will inherit the same opt-out settings and provide a short implementation timeline.
- Laura (Legal): Review opt-out wording and confirm whether a counter-signed PDF is sufficient.

I have attached a short SOC 2 summary and the Draft Opt-Out Confirmation for signature. If that looks good, Sam — please have your legal team sign and return the PDF and we will apply the setting within 24 hours for hosted accounts.

Thanks,
